pages.title: Hulk Smashing the Ground with Both Fists Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hulk driving both fists into cracked ground, with bent knees, large bare feet, and a gritted-teeth expression. Broken stones spread beneath his hands, while his torn shorts and broad shoulders define the crouched silhouette. The coloring sheet leaves wide muscle sections between the heavier outer contours.

pages.title: Hulk Lifting a Car Above His Head Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk raises a car above his head in this printable coloring page, supporting its underside with both hands while standing with his feet apart. Wheels, door handles, windows, and the front grille divide the vehicle into smaller sections. Broad body shapes and torn shorts sit beneath these details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hulk Breaking Free From Heavy Chains Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk pulls apart heavy chains in this printable coloring page, holding the broken ends in two fists above torn shorts and firmly planted bare feet. Large links curve toward the gap between his hands, where small fragments mark the break. The coloring sheet combines open muscle shapes with the repeated oval spaces inside the chain.

pages.title: Hulk Leaping Over City Buildings Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures Hulk leaping above city buildings, with one knee raised, the other leg bent back, and a fist reaching forward. His torn shorts and oversized feet remain prominent against the skyline. Small windows and cloud outlines add separate background sections around the larger figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hulk Throwing a Giant Boulder Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk prepares to throw a giant boulder in this printable coloring page, holding it above his shoulders with bent arms and a wide-legged stance. Angular cracks divide the rock into broad sections, while his fingers curve around its edges. The coloring sheet keeps the setting sparse, with a few ground stones below his feet.

pages.title: Hulk Crushing a Metal Barrel Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk crushes a barrel between both hands in this printable coloring page, with curled fingers, bent arms, and torn shorts above a broad standing pose. The barrel narrows around its buckled middle, and its raised rims remain clearly outlined. Large body sections surround the prop, making the central squeezing action prominent on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hulk Stopping a Runaway Train Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hulk bracing both hands against the front of a train, with bent elbows, spread fingers, and bare feet planted beside the tracks. A circular headlight, large windows, and the lower grille define the locomotive. Railway ties lead through the background, adding small repeated shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hulk Catching a Bus Falling From a Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk catches a falling bus in this printable coloring page, supporting the vehicle above his head beneath a broken bridge with dangling pieces of reinforcement. The bus has large windows, outlined wheels, and a broad front windshield. His bent arms and planted feet anchor the scene, while scattered rocks add smaller spaces to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hulk Smashing a Military Helicopter Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hulk smashing a military helicopter, gripping its damaged body beneath rotor blades while wires and broken pieces separate across his torso. Cockpit windows, landing skids, and the tail rotor provide recognizable aircraft details. His torn shorts and broad legs create open spaces below the smaller mechanical shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Bruce Banner Transforming Into Hulk and Tearing His Shirt Coloring Page
pages.description: Bruce Banner transforms into Hulk in this printable coloring page, pulling apart his torn shirt with both fists as ragged fabric hangs around his shoulders. An open collar frames his neck above the broad chest, while ripped trouser legs and a belt remain visible. The coloring sheet emphasizes the shirt grips and full standing figure.

pages.title: Hulk Meditating in the Mountains Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hulk meditating cross-legged on a rock, with closed eyes, both palms facing upward, and fingers arranged in matching circular gestures. Mountain peaks and rounded bushes form a sparse background around his shoulders. Torn shorts, crossed feet, and broad body contours give the coloring sheet several large enclosed sections.

pages.title: Gladiator Hulk Wearing Armor and Carrying an Axe and Hammer Coloring Page
pages.description: Gladiator Hulk carries an axe and a hammer in this printable coloring page, standing in layered armor with a shoulder plate, strapped chest, and shin guards. Each weapon has a distinct head and a continuous outlined handle. Rivets, belt details, and hanging armor panels add smaller sections around the broad figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Joe Fixit Hulk Wearing a Pinstripe Suit and Fedora Coloring Page
pages.description: Joe Fixit Hulk tips his fedora in this printable coloring page, wearing a pinstripe suit with a tie, waistcoat, pocket square, and large lace-up shoes. His other hand rests inside a trouser pocket, keeping the full standing pose relaxed. Narrow stripes run through the broad jacket and trouser sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Professor Hulk Wearing Glasses and Working in a Laboratory Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Professor Hulk working in a laboratory, wearing glasses and an open lab coat while holding a test tube and clipboard. A microscope, flasks, and a rack of tubes fill the bench and shelf behind him. Coat pockets, buttons, and simple equipment outlines give the coloring sheet a mix of broad and small sections.

pages.title: Hulk Wearing the Nano Gauntlet with All Six Infinity Stones Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk wears the Nano Gauntlet in this printable coloring page, raising an armored hand with all six Infinity Stones above his bent forearm and torn shorts. Segmented fingers, large stone settings, and stacked wrist plates distinguish the oversized glove. His opposite fist and full standing figure leave broad body sections around the mechanical details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Marvel Hulk Breaking Out of a Laboratory Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features LEGO Marvel Hulk breaking out of a laboratory, with large C-shaped hands, block-like feet, and a cracked opening around his body. An outlined DNA helix appears inside a tall chamber beside wall pipes and a control panel. The coloring sheet combines rounded bigfig muscles with angular pieces of broken masonry.

pages.title: Baby Hulk Holding a Feeding Bottle Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Hulk holds a feeding bottle in this printable coloring page, sitting with both feet forward beneath torn shorts and a large smiling face with tousled hair. His hands wrap around the bottle's marked body and ribbed cap. Broad cheeks, rounded limbs, and open soles provide large coloring areas with a few smaller enclosed details.

pages.title: Hulk Teaming Up with Devil Dinosaur Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page pairs Hulk with Devil Dinosaur, showing the hero's clenched fists beside the dinosaur's large toothed grin, short forearms, and curling tail. Patterned sections run along the dinosaur's head and body, contrasting with Hulk's broad chest and torn shorts. Both figures have clearly separated outlines against the coloring sheet's blank background.

pages.title: Hulk Standing Beside His Son Skaar Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk stands beside his son Skaar in this printable coloring page, resting a large hand on Skaar's shoulder above wrapped shins and a sheathed sword. Skaar's long hair and diagonal chest strap distinguish him from Hulk's shorter hairstyle and torn shorts. The coloring sheet keeps both complete figures prominent without adding a separate background scene.

pages.title: Hulk Fighting Abomination in a Ruined City Street Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk faces Abomination in this printable coloring page, with raised arms, clenched fists, torn shorts, and a ruined city street beneath their broad standing figures. Abomination's ear fins, pointed head ridges, and repeated body scales distinguish the two opponents. Broken walls, bent street furniture, and scattered rubble add smaller sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hulk Facing Off Against Red Hulk Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hulk facing Red Hulk, with both figures leaning forward, clenching their fists, and planting their bare feet among scattered rocks. Hulk's tousled hair contrasts with Red Hulk's flat-topped cut, while their torn shorts have different ragged edges. Broad shoulders and open leg shapes dominate the coloring sheet's sparse setting.

pages.title: Hulk Battling Wolverine Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk battles Wolverine in this printable coloring page, reaching with one open hand while raising his other fist behind Wolverine's bent-knee stance and pointed mask. Three outlined claws extend from each of Wolverine's gloves, and large boots anchor his spread legs. Torn shorts, costume panels, and ground rocks divide the coloring sheet into distinct sections.

pages.title: Hulk Fighting Thanos Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Hulk opposite Thanos, with raised fists, torn shorts, layered armor, and a jeweled gauntlet above scattered rocks around their feet. Thanos's ridged chin, shoulder plates, and large boots contrast with Hulk's bare chest and tousled hair. The full figures leave broad costume and body areas across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hulk Fighting the Thing From the Fantastic Four Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk fights the Thing in this printable coloring page, with each opponent raising a fist above a wide stance and smaller clenched hands near their torsos. The Thing's irregular rock panels cover his head, arms, chest, and legs, contrasting with Hulk's smooth muscle contours. Shorts and scattered rubble add separate sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hulk Confronting the Leader in a Gamma Laboratory Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hulk confronting the Leader in a gamma laboratory, with Hulk's clenched fists facing the Leader's pointing hand and long lab coat. The Leader's enlarged ridged head rises beside a tall cylindrical chamber and wall pipes. Control panels, belt details, and floor tiles add smaller shapes around the figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hulk and Thor Fighting Chitauri Invaders in New York Coloring Page
pages.description: Hulk and Thor fight Chitauri invaders in this printable coloring page, with Hulk punching one armored alien while Thor raises his hammer toward another opponent. Tall city buildings rise behind the two encounters, including a narrow spired tower. Capes, segmented armor, and scattered rubble give the coloring sheet a mixture of large and small sections.

pages.title: Hulk Holding Loki Upside Down By His Ankles Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hulk holding Loki upside down by his ankles, with Loki's arms hanging beside his horned helmet, cape, and layered costume. Hulk's large gripping hand sits above the two straight legs, while his other fist rests near his hip. The blank background leaves their full silhouettes clear on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Christmas Hulk Wearing a Santa Hat and Carrying a Sack of Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: Christmas Hulk carries a sack of presents in this printable coloring page, wearing a complete Santa hat with a rounded pom-pom above his tousled hair. Ribbon bows rise from the open sack behind his shoulder, and one hand grips its gathered neck. Torn shorts, broad muscles, and bare feet remain prominent on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Halloween Hulk Holding a Carved Jack-o-Lantern Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Halloween Hulk holding a carved jack-o-lantern in both hands, with angled eyes, a triangular nose, and a wide zigzag grin. A curved stem rises between his chest and the pumpkin's rounded sections. Torn shorts and bare feet complete the standing figure, while the coloring sheet keeps the background blank.
